brief.topic: How to compare two AI tools fairly
brief.audience: PMs and team leads choosing between AI tools
constraints: Example numbers are illustrative and labelled on screen and in caption

coreInsight: Compare AI tools on the same real tasks, scored blind, with cost and latency logged and the decision rule fixed before anyone sees results.

hooks.text: Your AI tool trial is rigged by accident.

caption.opening: If you decide how to judge after seeing the results, the best demo wins, not the best tool.
body:
A fair bake-off:
→ The same set of your real tasks for both tools
→ Blind scoring: hide which tool answered
→ Cost and wait time logged per task
→ The winning rule written down before you start
Illustrative example: rule = switch only with 3+ more passes. Result 15 vs 16 of 20. Keep the current tool.

claims.text: AI tool comparisons are fairer with identical real tasks, blind scoring, logged cost and latency, and a decision rule set in advance.
